Interestingly, if we monitor the average density at a given point along the ring, e.g. *⟨ρ*(*x₀,t*)*⟩*, we find persistent oscillations as a function of time for any packing order *m*, see Fig.4, a universal sig- nature of time-crystalline order [1–7,9–11,13,19– 23,25,27,28,38,84–91]. In order to determine the critical exponents char- acterizing the universality class of the observed phase transitions to these programmable time- crystal phases, we performed extensive measure- ments around the critical region in our Monte Carlo simulations. Due to the scale invariance underly- ing any continuous phase transitions, the relevant observables near the critical point are expected to be homogeneous functions of the two length scales characterizing the problem at hand, namely the cor- relation length *ξ* and the system size *L* [8,79].
